employees.evidence: treat them fairly and in the manner that we would wish to be treated if our positions were reversed

shareholders.evidence: is to maximize Berkshire’s average annual rate of gain in intrinsic business value on a per-share basis

integrity.evidence: We will be candid in our reporting to you, emphasizing the pluses and minuses important in appraising business value.

result.analyst_notes: Letter-style first-person voice, with Buffett and Munger as 'Charlie and I', frames shareholders as owner-partners. Per-share value and owner returns dominate. Candor pledges are absolute ('We will be candid'), while outcomes are hedged ('we hope', 'we expect'). Customers, communities, safety and innovation are essentially absent. Tone is folksy and aphoristic, e.g. 'We eat our own cooking.'
